text: Therefore, the venerable commentator [Patanjali] stated, "The purpose is [to resolve] the doubts concerning rakṣo, hā, gamala, and dhva" (Mahabhashya). Prosperity also arises from the correct use of words. Similarly, Katyayana has stated that prosperity resulting from usage based on the scriptures is equivalent to [the merit of] the words of the Vedas. Others have also said: "A single word, properly understood and correctly employed, becomes like a wish-fulfilling cow in heaven and on earth."
